notes.title: Update 0.0.7
notes.content: [h2]🛠️ Patch Notes – Smoother Gameplay, Cleaner Lobby! 🚗[/h2][p]This update brings a variety of improvements across visuals and gameplay. Here’s what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✔️ Main Menu Updates[/h3][list][*][p]A new [b]info panel[/b] has been added to the main menu showcasing upcoming features.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]✔️ Lobby & Entry Area Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Steam lobby codes[/b] are now easier to read.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player names[/b] are now correctly displayed in the waiting lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]lobby environment[/b] has been updated for a more polished and enjoyable look.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Gameplay & Physical Reactions[/h3][list][*][p]While pushing the car, your character's [b]muscles now flex and grow[/b] – feel the power![/p][/*][*][p]If a player falls off the map, [b]ragdoll mode[/b] is triggered for a more humorous fall.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💣 Explosives & Technical Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Exploding bombs[/b] are now visible to all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Bombs [b]reactivate after a short delay[/b] once exploded.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]respawn cooldown[/b] has been added to prevent spamming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where teleporting to the car would cause players to [b]float mid-air[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The car now [b]resets its position properly[/b] after respawning, making for smoother starts.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Plus:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Various minor bugs have been fixed[/b] for a better overall experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for playing! Your feedback means a lot to us 💪[/p]
